```yaml
name: Test Scheduled
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Daily at 2 AM UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - 'master'
      - 'release/*'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  test-all:
    name: Test All
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2', '8.4']
        db-type: ['mariadb', 'mysql']
        db-version: ['11.8', '8.4']
        include:
          - php-version: '8.2'
            db-type: 'mariadb'
            db-version: '11.8'
            coverage: true
          - php-version: '8.4'
            db-type: 'mariadb'
            db-version: '11.8'
            coverage: true
          - php-version: '8.4'
            db-type: 'mysql'
            db-version: '8.4'
            coverage: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, xsl, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

      - name: Wait for database
        run: |
          timeout=60
          i=0
          until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p"${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}" --silent; do
            if [ $i -ge $timeout ]; then
              echo "Database connection timed out"
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
            i=$((i+1))
          done

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover=coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.coverage == true
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          file: ./coverage.xml
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  phpstan:
    name: PHPStan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, xsl, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

      - name: Run PHPStan
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --error-format=checkstyle | tee phpstan-report.xml
        continue-on-error: true

  rector:
    name: Rector
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, xsl, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

      - name: Run Rector
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run

  styling-php:
    name: Styling (PHP)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, xsl, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

      - name: Run PHP-CS-Fixer
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff

  styling-js:
    name: Styling (JS)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: |
          npx eslint . --ext .js,.mjs,.ts

  styling-css:
    name: Styling (CSS)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci

      - name: Run Stylelint
        run: |
          npx stylelint "**/*.css" "**/*.scss"

  syntax:
    name: Syntax
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, xsl, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Parallel PHP syntax check
        run: |
          find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./vendor/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -P 4 -I {} php -l {}

  js-unit-test:
    name: JS Unit Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci

      - name: Run JS unit tests
        run: |
          npm test

  sql-lint:
    name: SQL Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install sqruff

      - name: Run SQL Lint
        run: |
          find . -name "*.sql" -print0 | xargs -0 -I {} sqruff parse {}

  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Semgrep
        uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: p/php p/javascript p/python
          publish_token: ${{ secrets.SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN }}
```
